scope: T04 / GTK2 native preview availability in existing private Xephyr :60
result: Available in the existing isolated session; not available from the normal Wayland app session by design.
diagnosis: The normal user session does not have access to the private Xephyr X server and its isolated preview processes. Both GTK2 preview processes were alive; one GtkPlug parent was non-viewable at inspection time, while the Theme Lab contained an attached GTK2 native canvas and separate GTK2 window. The existing Xephyr was activated and captured for the user.
limits: This confirms current native availability and process state, not historical visual acceptance or universal adapters. GTK1 gallery is unavailable because no runtime is installed.
